description: Header file defining platform-specific media codec creation functions for Android NDK, including functions to create codecs by name or MIME type on behalf of a client with specified uid and pid, introduced in API level 31.

methods.name: AMediaCodec_createCodecByNameForClient
methods.description: Creates a media codec by name for a specific client identified by uid and pid, available since API 31.

methods.name: AMediaCodec_createDecoderByTypeForClient
methods.description: Creates a decoder by MIME type for a specific client identified by uid and pid, available since API 31.

methods.name: AMediaCodec_createEncoderByTypeForClient
methods.description: Creates an encoder by MIME type for a specific client identified by uid and pid, available since API 31.
